summary: ```# Ten-Minute Beginner Tutorial - Puff Sleeve Shirt ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will guide you through the process of creating a puff sleeve shirt using Marvelous Designer. This step-by-step guide is designed for beginners and will cover everything from downloading the virtual model to adjusting sleeve patterns. ## Setting Up the Scene 1. **Download Virtual Model**: Start by downloading the virtual model and adding the default T-shirt to the scene. 2. **Automatic Adjustment Panel Tool**: Use the automatic adjustment panel tool to make the panel match the size of the virtual model. 3. **Checking Fit**: Switch to semi-transparent mode to check if the clothes fit the model. ## Adjusting the T-Shirt Panels 1. **Moving Lines**: When moving the straight line, press the CTRL key to move in the direction of the outline of the panel. To enter the distance of movement, press the right mouse button. 2. **Shoulder Line Length**: Ensure that the shoulder line length of the front and back panels is correct. Adjust the shoulder of the T-shirt if it appears narrower. 3. **Sleeve Curves**: Adjust the curve of the sleeves to make it smoother, ensuring the clothes fit more intimately. 4. **Collar Adjustment**: Drag the straight line of the front and middle collar downwards to create the effect of the body collar. 5. **Waistline Adjustment**: Adjust the curve of the waistline to create a rectangle at the corner of the panel and to ensure a better fit. ## Finalizing the Sleeve Patterns 1. **Lengthening Sleeves**: Erase extra points and lengthen the sleeve patterns. After lengthening the sleeve panel, if it is pierced, rearrange it to resolve the piercings. 2. **Panel Expansion**: Use the panel to expand the outer edge, extending the side angle along the curve. 3. **Front Seam Line**: Since you need to add a button, delete the front seam line first. ## Adding Buttons 1. **Creating a Button**: Use the round and smooth curve tool to add corners for the button. 2. **Editing Buttons**: Utilize the edit button tool to copy and paste the button. When pasting, right-click to set the number of buttons and the distance between them. 3. **Symmetrical Copying**: In the right-click menu, you can copy the button to the symmetrical panel or turn any side of the button into an eye. 4. **Center Button Adjustment**: Select the center button using the thin button tool, then click on the corresponding eye button to place the button. ## Adjusting the Outer Edge of the Front Panel 1. **Smoothing the Bottom Panel**: Adjust the length of the outer edge of the front panel and increase the curve point to make the bottom panel smoother. Repeat this step for consistency. 2. **Final Adjustments**: Add a curve point and adjust it to the right angle to ensure the bottom panel remains smooth. ## Creating the Embroidery 1. **Starting Point for Embroidery**: Select the 3D panel of the line and create a starting point for the embroidery dragon section. 2. **Adding Curve Points**: Press CTRL to add a curve point. Double-click the 3D panel of the line to finalize it. 3. **Editing the 3D Panel**: Use the edit 3D panel tool to adjust the top and curve of the line. ## Ensuring Proper Fit 1. **Adjusting Panel Lines**: When the starting and end points are on the panel line, you can adjust them. Check for any deformations in the line within the 2D window. 2. **Editing Curves**: If deformations are detected, set it as an internal shape and edit its curve. ## Finalizing the Side Seam 1. **Internal Line Creation**: Use the internal line to create an internal line and cut it into a braid to form the sleeve. 2. **Sewing Lines**: Create the first sewing line on the embossed line and press the Shift key to create a second sewing line along it. 3. **Stabilizing Molding**: Freeze the sheet other than the sleeve to ensure stability. ## Adjusting Elasticity 1. **Selecting the Embossed Line**: Select the outer line of the embossed line and adjust the elastic ratio to 100% to prevent stretching. 2. **Application of Sleeve**: Give the sleeve an application to stick, ensuring the shape maintains its form. ## Final Adjustments and Simulation 1. **Reducing Shrinkage**: Reduce the tail-shape shrinkage of the front and back panels to closely attach them to the virtual model. 2. **Simulating Layers**: Reactivate the pants and simulate; the top will tighten. Freeze the top panel while applying layers that are higher for the pants. 3. **Invisible Buttons**: Eliminate invisible buttons to avoid instability. 4. **Final Layer Adjustments**: Adjust the shrinkage to the default value of 100%. Once the clothing is stable, turn all the clothing layers back to zero for alignment. ## Conclusion This concludes the beginner tutorial on creating a puff sleeve shirt in Marvelous Designer. Practice these steps to enhance your skills in garment design and simulation. ```
